name: Nager.Date public holidays

measures.definition: Public holidays that fall on Monday to Friday this year, nationwide plus those of the city's region.

rights.attribution: Public holidays from Nager.Date (date.nager.at), MIT License, Copyright (c) Nager

vetted.notes: Open-source holiday rules with a free, keyless API; the API answers browsers (CORS open).

caveats: Holidays moved off a weekend by law count where Nager.Date lists the moved date.
Regional holidays count only when the city's ISO region code matches the one Nager.Date uses.
